title: tac.track.get
description: One track in full: identity, IFF and id state, sources, position, kinematics, quality, age, threat, engagement, missile target and BRAA from ref. Needs the BDArmory binding in a flight scene (EXECUTOR_UNAVAILABLE tactical_not_attached without it).

view.description: Picture to read: a team name (your own side unless you are a human, referee or director), or "god" for the truth (needs privilege or fog off). Defaults to the session's side.

ref.description: reference unit for BRAA: a handle "v:<id>", a vessel id or an exact unit name.

units.description: distance units for text: nm (naval: nm, kt, ft) or km (metric)
